title: Claim frontier · preservar routing de contention barriers

target.capability: compact claim frontier contention-barrier authority projection

semantic_identity.problem: compact claim frontier can resurrect direct portfolio pin candidates for expired contention-barrier fixtures after allocator routing
acceptance: active and released barriers preserve entrant/release membership gating before deterministic pin
an expired barrier with prior timeout evidence is suppressed from ordinary claim candidates
an expired barrier without prior timeout evidence exposes only the timeout receipt path with pin_attempted false
expired contention barriers never expose a direct portfolio pin claim_path in live claim-frontier
ordinary non-barrier portfolio jobs remain direct-to-pin

mission: Repará la compilación compacta de claim-frontier para que nunca reintroduzca el PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE previo a routing de un contention barrier. La representación final ya ruteada del allocator debe conservar timeout/enter/release/suppression antes de cualquier autoridad PIN.
definition_of_done: Una regresión determinista reproduce un batch candidate con PIN crudo y una lane final ruteada y demuestra que claim-frontier conserva la representación ruteada, no el PIN crudo.
Barrier expirado sin timeout previo expone únicamente timeout receipt con pin_attempted=false, nunca G000001.
Barrier expirado con timeout durable queda suprimido del frontier ordinario.
Barriers activos o RELEASED preservan entrant/release membership gate antes del PIN determinista.
Jobs ordinarios sin barrier mantienen direct-to-PIN sin regresión.
La proyección live compilada ya no expone los fixtures expirados observados como claim directo G000001.
truth_boundary: Control-plane routing repair only; execution authority remains the normal post-barrier portfolio PIN.
